title: Wildcard attestation notes — Imani (SOC2 prep)
body:
Purpose / context:
- Personal scratchpad for SOC2 readiness activities — not official evidence bundle.
- Focus areas for upcoming audit simulation: user access, key management, incident triage, change control for infra.
- Quick capture of questions to escalate to legal / infosec / infra.

Topline observations (raw):
- Onboarding checklist is OK but lacks explicit periodic revalidation step (90/180-day review?). tickets: REINF-235 (needs owner).
- Service accounts: some long-lived keys in infra repo (aws creds in legacy terraform). Need rotation plan + proof.
- Console audit logs: retention 30 days by default; auditors will ask about access to historical traces/retention policy.
- Dedicated vs hosted: customers on Dedicated require different evidence (network configs, VPC flow logs). Mock sample needed.

Control mapping brainstorm (very rough):
- Security (CC):
  - Access provisioning: onboarding/offboarding flow (PR: #228) -> evidence: joiner/leaver tickets, HR offboard CSV, IAM policy snapshots (date stamped).
  - MFA enforcement: backup codes? admin bypass exceptions need whitelisting table. Capture exceptions log.
- Availability:
  - Capacity planning: dedicated capacity commit documents + autoscaling runbook (ops playbook v2). Metrics: 99.9% target baseline.
- Confidentiality / Encryption:
  - KMS usage: production keys in KMS (kms-prod-main)
